calls.function: execute(bytes commands, bytes[] inputs, uint256 deadline)

encoded.as: SETTLE(address currency, uint256 amount, bool payerIsUser)

SWAP_EXACT_IN_SINGLE(((address currency0, address currency1, uint24 fee, int24 tickSpacing, address hooks) poolKey, bool zeroForOne, uint128 amountIn, uint128 amountOutMinimum, uint256 minHopPriceX36, bytes hookData) params)

route.en: It only picks which USDC/USDT pool with no hook and tick spacing 1 trades, and with it the price. No hook code runs in any of them, SETTLE pays exactly the card's amount, and a pool that would pay less than the card's minimum makes the swap revert. The app used fees 7, 8, 10, 35 and 100 in the transactions read.
route.zh-TW: 它只決定用哪一個沒有 hook、tick spacing 是 1 的 USDC/USDT 池子，也就是價格。這些池子都不執行 hook 程式碼，SETTLE 付的剛好是卡片上的數量，池子給的少於卡片上的最低值時 swap 會 revert。讀過的交易裡 app 用過 7、8、10、35 和 100。

free.en: The direction inside the pool: true sells USDC, false sells USDT. The pool lists the two tokens by address, so the app sets it from the token being sold. SETTLE pays in the card's sell token and TAKE takes out the card's buy token whatever this says, so the other direction leaves the payment unspent and a debt in the buy token, and the swap reverts. The perturbation test shows it.
free.zh-TW: 在池子裡的方向：true 是賣 USDC，false 是賣 USDT。池子按地址排列這兩個代幣，所以 app 依賣出的代幣設定它。不管它寫什麼，SETTLE 付進去的都是卡片上的賣出代幣，TAKE 取出的都是卡片上的買入代幣；方向相反時，付進去的錢沒被用掉、又欠了買入代幣，swap 會 revert。擾動測試有證明。

encoded.as: TAKE(address currency, address recipient, uint256 amount)

free.en: The time after which the router refuses the swap, which the app sets when it builds the transaction. A later deadline only lets the transaction run later; the Safe still gives exactly the card's amount and gets at least the card's minimum.
free.zh-TW: 超過這個時間 router 就拒絕這筆 swap，app 在組交易時設定。較晚的期限只會讓交易可以晚一點執行；Safe 給出的仍然剛好是卡片上的數量，拿到的也至少是卡片上的最低值。

why.en: The Uniswap app appends a 22-byte tag that starts with the ASCII bytes unix and holds a timestamp: in the one Safe transaction of this shape found and in each of the 413 direct calls of it read. execute reads only its three arguments, as the router's registry entry says (ignoresTrailer).
why.zh-TW: Uniswap app 會在後面附上一個 22 bytes、以 ASCII bytes unix 開頭、帶有時間戳記的標記：找到的一筆這種形狀的 Safe 交易，和讀過的 413 筆直接呼叫都是。execute 只讀它的三個引數，和 router 的登記項目寫的一樣（ignoresTrailer）。
